item.title: Hinojosa Vows Moderation, Backs Trump on Border Security
item.description: Texas Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa, the first Democrat to win the office in more than three decades, told The Washington Post she will avoid culture wars ...

item.title: Justice Alito warns America must preserve 3 core principles regardless of country’s ‘atmosphere’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito outlined three principles he says Americans must always prioritize amid the 2026 midterms and the Iran War.

item.title: Dems seize on midterm rout to demand ICE reform but polls reveal a twist in who prioritized immigration
item.description: Rep.-elect Bobby Pulido and Texas Democrats push 2028 candidates to prioritize immigration reform after flipping Republican-leaning districts.

item.title: Democrats eye killing Senate filibuster as lawmaker warns move could be a 'double-edged sword'
item.description: Ed Markey says the filibuster must be "on the table" as Democrats take the Senate, while Andy Kim warns the move could be a "double-edged sword."
